entries.name: OBST_SPEED
entries.description: pixels the block moves left each frame, 1 to 6 (0xFC is 4)

entries.name: FRAME_DELAY
entries.description: ticks to wait per frame, 2 normal and 1 double speed

entries.name: JUMP_STEP
entries.description: pixels gained per frame while rising (0xFD is 3 up)
